Conditions, all binding:

(2) It ships with a PUBLIC parity guarantee — snapshot+tail === full fold — as a citable test, alongside the order-independence property (fold is identical regardless of arrival order).
(3) No wall-clock or environment input in the folded result, so replay is deterministic.
(4) Semver-stable surface: sofar-cloud and the Mac app depend on it.
(5) Not in the RC. It lands in the NEXT release after round-2 evidence, so the RC that round 2 measures stays exactly what was frozen (D20, D23).
